description: Portrait of O'Keeffe dressed in a black wrap dress with her Hector Aguilar belt sitting back in modernist lounge chair listening to classical music. The white drapes are drawn, one of her chows lays in the chair adjacent to her, on the table in the foreground are a pair of high-heels and  part of a woman's skirt and and are visible on the couch. In the background is the table with the stereo components. Small paintings hang on opposite walls, 2 drawings are propped against a shelf on the viewer left side of photograph.
title: O'Keeffe listening to Madrigals
